title: Quenched Jordanian Lamb Mansaf
description: A resinous, snappy variation of classic Mansaf featuring lamb simmered in a yogurt sauce and topped with a crisp, honey‑saffron glazed filo pastry crust.
instructions: Whisk yogurt, minced garlic, sumac, lemon juice, salt, pepper, cumin, and saffron water until smooth.
In a large pot, brown lamb cubes in a splash of oil over medium‑high heat, then pour in the yogurt mixture.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 60 minutes until lamb is tender and sauce thickens.
While lamb cooks, lay filo sheets in a greased baking dish, brushing each sheet with melted butter and stacking them to form a layered crust.
When lamb is done, spoon it over the filo crust, leaving a small border around the edges.
Drizzle honey glaze over the lamb and bake the assembled dish for 15 minutes until filo is golden and crispy.
Remove from oven and let rest 5 minutes.
Sprinkle chopped parsley over the finished dish.
Serve immediately with extra yogurt sauce on the side.
